title: The Quiet Orbit
paragraphs: Mara opened the observatory before dawn. The city below was still dark, but one window across the river shone like a patient star.

She had spent a year measuring distant light. This morning she left the telescope covered and watched the neighborhood wake. A baker lifted a shutter. A cyclist stopped to mend a chain. Each small motion was its own orbit.
In her notebook she wrote: Attention is a way of arriving. Then she went downstairs to share the first loaf.
